name: Threads
summary:
Get immersive in your conversations with your friends and followers with Threads VR.

See what people are talking about right now—from niche interests to big moments. Reply, listen, share or just follow along. 

Here’s what you can do on Threads VR:

■ Start a thread, share your take
Have something on your mind? Take it to Threads. Share a thought, ask a question or open up a conversation. There’s more than one way to kick things off with text, images, polls, ghost posts and more.

■ Jump into replies
